
  ▲ vercel logs [command] [options]

  Display logs.                                                                 
  Defaults: linked project, all environments, latest 100 records, last 30m.     
  Display the selected records from newest to oldest.                           
  Use --since 1h for the last hour; --until 1h ends one hour ago.               
  Without --since, the window is the 30m before --until (or now). Start must be 
  before end.                                                                   
  requestId filters use the same window; set --since and --until as needed.     
  Query context and Next page commands are printed on stderr.                   
  --json prints typed lines and ends with a summary; --non-interactive implies  
  --json.                                                                       
  --next keeps the original target, filter, and window, and uses the team in    
  the cursor.                                                                   
  Paging is best-effort: records sharing a timestamp at a page boundary can     
  repeat or be skipped.                                                         
  Team-owned projects only.                                                     

  Data sources:

  runtime     Display runtime log entries (default)                     
  requests    Display CDN request records                               


  Options:

       --deployment <DEPLOYMENT>    Filter to a deployment ID or URL            
  -e,  --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  Filter by environment, including custom     
                                    environments                                
       --json                       Output JSON Lines ending with a summary line
  -n,  --limit <NUMBER>             Limit returned records (default: 100, max:  
                                    10000)                                      
       --next <CURSOR>              Continue a previous query from its summary's
                                    next value                                  
  -p,  --project <NAME_OR_ID>       Select a project (default: linked project)  
  -q,  --query <EXPRESSION>         Filter the selected source with KQL-inspired
                                    syntax                                      
  -s,  --since <TIME>               Start time: ISO 8601, relative, or now      
                                    (default: 30m before the end)               
  -u,  --until <TIME>               End time: ISO 8601, relative, or now        
                                    (default: now)                              


  Common --query fields:

  runtime (default)                                                             
    level, source, environment, deploymentId, requestId, domain,                
    requestPath, requestMethod, region, service, traceId, spanId,               
    runtime, stream, isSystemLog, truncated                                     
    Unquoted bare words search log messages.                                    
    Common values:                                                              
      source: function, middleware, ci, edge, daemon                            
      level:  error, warning, info, fatal                                       
      stream: stdout, stderr                                                    

  requests                                                                      
    environment, deploymentId, requestId, requestHostname,                      
    requestPath, requestMethod, httpStatus, route, cacheResult,                 
    edgeNetworkRegion, service                                                  
    Use field expressions to filter request records.                            
    Background function executions are excluded.                                

  Additional public fields supported by the API are accepted.                   
  Use vercel logs runtime --help or vercel logs requests --help for types and   
  examples.                                                                     

  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - Display recent runtime logs

    $ vercel logs

  - Find runtime errors in production

    $ vercel logs --query 'level:error AND environment:production'

  - Display CDN requests with server errors

    $ vercel logs requests --query 'httpStatus >= 500'

  - Output logs for a deployment as JSON Lines

    $ vercel logs --deployment dpl_xxxxx --json

  - Continue from the summary's next value

    $ vercel logs --next <CURSOR> --json
